description:
6+ years of software development experience in shipping and maintaining online services including 
 · Deep knowledge of building large scale and customer-facing REST services and user experiences 
 · Expertise in ASP.NET MVC, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and in an OOP language (C#/Java/Swift/C++) 
 · Strong analytical and debugging skills, experience with data analysis and log-based debugging in production environments is a plus 
 · Strong theory/algorithms background and exceptional problem solving and analytical skills. 
 · Deep knowledge in information retrieval, data mining, building large-scale distributed systems is a bonus. 
 · Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written 
 · Ability and willingness to work independently and in a team to research innovative solutions to challenging technical problems 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
